products.name: Jamf AI Governance
products.note: Native AI control plane for macOS fleets, GA July 1, 2026; discovery and policy enforcement for on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints

profile_text.body:
Jamf is a software company specializing in the management and security of Apple devices, with over 20 years of experience in the space. The company describes itself as offering a platform that covers Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Apple TV devices, ranging from small deployments to tens of thousands of endpoints. Its stated focus is on mobile device management, connecting users to resources, and protecting organizations from cyber threats, and it claims an unmatched reputation for same-day Apple OS support along with hundreds of third-party integrations. IDC MarketScape has positioned Jamf in the Leaders Category for Worldwide Unified Endpoint Management Software for Apple Devices in the 2025–2026 Vendor Assessment.

On the AI side, Jamf has a product called Jamf AI Governance, described as a native AI control plane for macOS fleets, with general availability set for July 1, 2026. The product is designed to provide discovery and policy enforcement for both on-device and cloud AI use on Mac endpoints, placing it in the category of AI governance and risk management platforms.
